prompt: Challenge C022-CH3: We want to add a water-balance module so farmers can plan irrigation scheduling, but none of our staff understands evapotranspiration modell

content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Evapotranspiration is estimated using the Penman–Monteith equation in studies of groundwater recharge in Vojvodina's agricultural regions.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-03044","field":"abstract","quote":"summer evapotranspiration computed by the Penman–Monteith equation"}]},{"text":"Soil moisture dynamics and water balance can be modeled using continuous monitoring at multiple depths combined with meteorological data to estimate actual evapotranspiration and recharge.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-03046","field":"abstract","quote":"Soil moisture was logged continuously at three depths using capacitance probes; actual evapotranspiration was estimated from eddy covariance measurements"}]},{"text":"Teaching responsibilities in irrigation and drainage engineering are part of the group's academic portfolio for undergraduate and master's level instruction.","sources":[{"id":"R0240","field":"bio","quote":"Teaching responsibilities include Hydrogeology, Irrigation and Drainage, and Water Resources Planning"}]}],"fit":"partial","fitReason":"The researcher has demonstrated experience with Penman–Monteith evapotranspiration calculations and soil-water balance monitoring in Vojvodina [SYN-PUB-03044, SYN-PUB-03046], but published work focuses on groundwater recharge estimation rather than crop-specific water balance or irrigation scheduling algorithms, and does not address integration with crop coefficients or spatial soil-type datasets required for the challenge."}
